relationship: Cell flux is aggregated into power and flux descriptors and compared with the AFD control limit; the full cell field is not a scalar registered candidate.
Subregion mean fluxes are differenced before deriving registered rate summaries and peak-location IDs.
Signed rate vector over 126 subregions; Rrec is its maximum positive part and other candidates summarize its distribution or peak IDs.
Clear-sky reference power is used to construct P_loss; it is not a separately registered predictor.
Cell-level physical AFD control limit used to construct afd_violation_ratio; distinct from the statistical E1 event threshold.
Cell utilization q_j divided by q_AFD_ctrl_j; its exceedance fraction is afd_violation_ratio. R_j is distinct from Rrec.
Activity vector determines aggregate shading and flux reconstruction; individual heliostat states are not separate scalar registry fields.
Fixed per-heliostat optical flux library used upstream of receiver features; not a registered predictor.
Recorded time separation supplies rate denominators; it is not a separately registered predictor.
Statistical thresholds applied to physical indicators to construct event states; threshold parameters are not predictors.
Raw threshold states determine episode construction and online anchor eligibility; they are not registered candidate inputs.
